{{Quote|Imperial emergency code three-delta-delta. This is Grand Moff Ravik. I have taken command of the Rebel vessel ''Celestial'' and await pickup by the ISD ''Relentless''. I am broadcasting our coordinates now. Request immediate response as the situation is still fluid.|Grand Moff Ravik|<ref name="Otherspace" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], [[Prisoner/Legends|inmates]] and crewmembers aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ship]] ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]'' '''mutinied''' and took control of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Rebel [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alain Gryphon]] sent the vessel to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] before [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] reinforcements could arrive, but a damaged [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] saw the ''Celestial'' end up in the mysterious dimension known as [[Otherspace]].

The Rebel [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|ship]] ''[[Long Shot]]'' and the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]'' arrived on the scene of the revolt shortly thereafter, and after a brief [[Space warfare/Legends|shoot-out]], the former also fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], only to end up in Otherspace itself. The ''Relentless''{{'s}} captain [[Westen]] was removed from his post for his failure to capture the ''Celestial''.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Apology accepted, Captain Parlan.|Darth Vader, after executing Parlan via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]|<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>}}
At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="Date note 1" /> and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date note 2" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ship]] ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]'' was transporting [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to the Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] of [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]].<ref name="Otherspace II: Invasion">''[[Otherspace II: Invasion]]''</ref> Meanwhile, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Westen]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took command of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]'' after its former captain, [[Ranif Parlan]], disappointed and was [[Telekinesis/Legends|executed]] by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="CSWE Parlan">{{CSWECite|III|13|Parlan}}</ref>

==The mutiny==
{{Quote|Situation report, Commander.''"<br />"''The Celestial's crew is ordinary, Grand Moff. Ordinary men panic when their ship loses power and mobility. Survival becomes paramount.''"<br />"''Scared men are easy to command, given the promise of safety.''"<br />"''Some will stay loyal to Gryphon.''"<br />(smiling) "''I am sure we will think of something, Commander.|Grand Moff Ravik and Bane Nothos|<ref name="Otherspace" />}}
While the ''Celestial'' was waiting in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] to rendezvous with the Rebel [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|ship]] ''[[Long Shot]]'', Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bane Nothos]] broke free from his holding cell and released the other inmates, including the Empire's [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Celis Mott]], and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Zardra]] and [[EL-434]]. The Imperials then caused a power loss that damaged the ''Celestial''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and the prison break turned into a mutiny—many of the Rebel crew submitted to Ravik and Nothos's leadership when they realized they were adrift without an immediate hope of rescue.<ref name="Otherspace" />

Nothos sent a [[Distress beacon/Legends|distress call]] to the nearest Imperial base, and Ravik broadcasted their coordinates to the nearby ''Relentless''. However, the desperate captain of the ''Celestial'', [[Alain Gryphon]], sent the ship into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] despite its malfunctioning drive. The ship was deposited into the mysterious dimension known as [[Otherspace]].<ref name="Otherspace" />

[[File:Relentless2-Otherspace.jpg|thumb|left|275px|The ''Relentless'' battles the ''Long Shot''.]]
When the ''Relentless'' arrived at the given coordinates, it found only empty space. Captain [[Westen]] sent out a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], and when the ''Long Shot'' subsequently showed up, it collided with a TIE and damaged its own hyperdrive. As it [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], a [[Unidentified Imperial lieutenant (Westen)|lieutenant]] aboard the ''Relentless'' calculated possible jump routes the ''Celestial'' could have taken. None of the routes stood out over any other, and Westen—worried about disappointing [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader himself—elected to interrogate the ''Long Shot''{{'s}} crew to get the information he wanted. His ploy failed when the ''Long Shot'' escaped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="Otherspace" />

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|Mott|She's dead, Moff. ''Celestial'' has had it. We couldn't build a solid system boat out of what's left.|Ravik|Nothos, what have you got on that asteroid or planetoid&hellip; whatever&hellip; out there.|Nothos|"Grand Moff, I believe the object out there is a ship.|attr=Celis Mott, Grand Moff Ravik, and Bane Nothos discover the ''Desolate'' in Otherspace|src=<ref name="Otherspace" />}}
The ''Long Shot''{{'s}} damaged hyperdrive saw it, too, end up in Otherspace, where it found the ''Celestial'' abandoned and dying. Nothos and Ravik had taken everyone in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] to the nearby ''[[Desolate]]'', a ship belonging to the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] inhabitants of Otherspace: the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]]. The ''Long Shot''{{'s}} crew boarded ''Desolate'' themselves and took the [[Skirmish on the Desolate|fight]] to the Charon.<ref name="Otherspace" /> Meanwhile, Vader removed Westen from his post.<ref name="CSWE Relentless" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If the PCs surrender or are captured by the Star Destroyer's tractor beams you will have to improvise a storyline. So it is probably better to give the Rebels a break &hellip; but make them earn it.|''Otherspace'', instructing its [[Wikipedia:Gamemaster|gamemaster]]|<ref name="Otherspace" />}}
As the mutiny on the ''Celestial'' forms part of the [[West End Games]] adventure book ''[[Otherspace (adventure)|Otherspace]]'', the identities of the Rebel crew of the ''Long Shot'' are chosen and customized by the players themselves. Their battle with the ''Relentless'' can go any number of ways, including an escape from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] after being captured by its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]].<ref name="Otherspace" />
